# AI Policy

> **Draft.** The final wording is decided by the wayfinder ticket on agent-native repository
> layout and contribution policy.

This project is built *with* AI coding agents and is designed to be easy for them to work in: the
repository carries the context, skills and executable checks an agent needs. That openness comes
with one non-negotiable rule:

**A human owns every line that is merged.** Whoever opens a pull request must understand the
change, be able to explain it in their own words, and answer review questions themselves. Do not
paste AI-generated replies to maintainers; if you quote an AI, mark it as a quote and say why it
matters.

Fully autonomous pull requests — opened and driven by an agent without a person who understands
the work — are closed without review.

Using AI to translate or polish English you wrote yourself is welcome.

Wording adapted from the [Astral AI policy](https://github.com/astral-sh/.github/blob/main/AI_POLICY.md) (MIT).
